title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is given by $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$. Think about how each function f(x) might transform the $$x$$ values and how that could affect the linearity of the data.

title: Analyzing $$f(x)=-x$$
text: Consider what happens to the $$x$$ values when you apply $$f(x)=-x$$. How does this transformation affect the relationship between $$x$$ and $$y$$ in the scatterplot?

title: Checking Linearity
text: Does applying $$f(x)=-x$$ maintain a linear relationship between $$x$$ and $$y$$ in the scatterplot?
